name: Smart & Multifunctional Materials
summary: Surveys materials that sense and respond to their environment, which are the building blocks of adaptive structures, actuators and wearable systems.

topics.name: What makes a material smart: coupled fields and transduction
Piezoelectric actuators and sensors: stacks, benders and design equations
Magnetorheological and electrorheological fluids and elastomers
Chromogenic materials: thermochromic, photochromic and electrochromic
Structural health monitoring with embedded smart materials
Comparing actuator materials: strain, stress, energy density, bandwidth and efficiency
